candidate.original_question: According to the passage, what happens if the causes of action on which such suits or proceedings are based had arisen after such establishment?
candidate.proposed_question: What may a law under Article 323A(2)(e) provide for in relation to certain cases pending when an administrative tribunal is established?
candidate.proposed_answer: It may provide for transfer to the tribunal of cases pending before a court or other authority immediately before establishment that would have fallen within the tribunal's jurisdiction if their causes of action had arisen after establishment.
candidate.source_text_finding: Article 323A(2)(e) supports transfer of qualifying matters pending before a court/authority immediately before tribunal establishment, assessed by whether they would have been within the tribunal jurisdiction had the cause arisen after establishment.
